title: Grok LSP Server Configuration
description: `~/.grok/lsp.json` (user) and `<cwd>/.grok/lsp.json` (project) — a flat JSON object mapping server name to `LspServerConfig`, NOT wrapped in an outer key. Parsed directly via `serde_json::from_str::<BTreeMap<String, LspServerConfig>>`; a missing/unreadable file yields an empty map (no error). Project config is gated by folder trust: `filter_project_lsp_when_untrusted` drops project-sourced servers entirely when the workspace is untrusted, and the project-file presence itself is one of the signals used by the folder-trust prompt gate. User config is the base; project config overrides by server name; a `plugin.json` manifest's inline `lspServers` value shares this exact same `BTreeMap<String, LspServerConfig>` shape and only fills in server names not already present from user/project (`.or_insert_with`, never overrides) — so this one definition covers both the standalone file and the plugin-manifest-embedded form.

lspServerConfig.description: `struct LspServerConfig` (config.rs:229-258). Serialized field names are snake_case; SEVEN of the eleven optional fields also accept a camelCase alias via `#[serde(alias = "...")]` — `command`, `args`, `env`, `transport`, and `settings` do NOT have a camelCase alias. Because no `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` is present, this schema never sets `additionalProperties: false`.

command.description: Executable to launch the LSP server. `command: String` — the only field without `#[serde(default)]`; required. No camelCase alias.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to `command`. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>`. No camelCase alias.

transport.description: Wire transport. `#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")] enum LspTransport { Stdio (default), Socket }`. No camelCase alias (already lowercase).

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to the server process. `#[serde(default)] HashMap<String, String>`. No camelCase alias.

extensions.description: Canonical spelling: maps a file extension (e.g. ".rs") to an LSP languageId (e.g. "rust"). `#[serde(default, alias = "extensionToLanguage", alias = "extensionToLanguageId")] HashMap<String, String>`. Aliases: `extensionToLanguage`, `extensionToLanguageId` (see below).

extensionToLanguage.description: Alias spelling for `extensions` — same field, same shape. Documents that supplying this key populates `extensions`; supplying both `extensions` and this alias in the same document is a serde duplicate-field error, not modeled by JSON Schema.

extensionToLanguageId.description: Second alias spelling for `extensions` — same field, same shape as `extensions`/`extensionToLanguage`.

initialization_options.description: Canonical spelling: arbitrary JSON passed as the LSP `initializationOptions` payload. `#[serde(default, alias = "initializationOptions")] Option<serde_json::Value>`, default null. Alias: `initializationOptions`.

initializationOptions.description: Alias spelling for `initialization_options` — same field, arbitrary JSON value.

settings.description: Arbitrary JSON passed as the LSP `workspace/didChangeConfiguration` settings payload. `#[serde(default)] Option<serde_json::Value>`, default null. NO camelCase alias (already lowercase, and unlike the others has no alternate spelling at all).

workspace_folder.description: Canonical spelling: workspace root path/URI advertised to the server. `#[serde(default, alias = "workspaceFolder")] Option<String>`, default null. Alias: `workspaceFolder`.

workspaceFolder.description: Alias spelling for `workspace_folder` — same field, same string type.

startup_timeout.description: Canonical spelling: milliseconds to wait for server startup. `#[serde(default, alias = "startupTimeout")] Option<u64>` — no serde-level default constant; `startup_timeout_ms()` accessor substitutes 15000 when None. Alias: `startupTimeout`.

startupTimeout.description: Alias spelling for `startup_timeout` — same field, same integer-milliseconds semantics.

shutdown_timeout.description: Canonical spelling: milliseconds to wait for graceful server shutdown. `#[serde(default, alias = "shutdownTimeout")] Option<u64>`; `shutdown_timeout_ms()` accessor substitutes 5000 when None. Alias: `shutdownTimeout`.

shutdownTimeout.description: Alias spelling for `shutdown_timeout` — same field, same integer-milliseconds semantics.

restart_on_crash.description: Canonical spelling: whether to auto-restart the server after a crash. `#[serde(default, alias = "restartOnCrash")] Option<bool>`; `restart_on_crash()` accessor substitutes false when None. Alias: `restartOnCrash`.

restartOnCrash.description: Alias spelling for `restart_on_crash` — same field, same boolean semantics.

max_restarts.description: Canonical spelling: maximum restart attempts across the lifetime of a server monitor (a lifetime budget, not per-crash-episode counter). `#[serde(default, alias = "maxRestarts")] Option<u32>`; `max_restarts()` accessor substitutes 3 when None. Alias: `maxRestarts`.

maxRestarts.description: Alias spelling for `max_restarts` — same field, same integer semantics.
